CustomObject.description: Holds the Google Maps Geocoding API key used by HCOGeocodingQueueable to turn an HCO's billing address into Geolocation__c coordinates. Deliberately not granted to any rep-facing permission set — only Apex (system mode) ever reads it. A single "Default" record; set Google_Maps_API_Key__c here in Setup after deployment (never via a metadata deploy, so the key is never in source control).
CustomObject.label: Geocoding Config
